types.name: The web, websites and URLs
types.description: Asks about Internet and WWW history, web terms (web page, home page, hyperlink, HTML), parts of a URL or domain extensions.

types.name: Browsers, cookies and browser shortcuts
types.description: Names a browser or browser feature (tabs, bookmarks, cache, cookies, incognito, rendering engine) or asks for a browser keyboard shortcut.

types.name: IP addresses, MAC and DNS
types.description: Asks about IPv4 or IPv6 size and format, IP classes, MAC addresses, DNS, DHCP or how a name becomes an address.

types.name: Protocols and port numbers
types.description: Names a protocol (HTTP, FTP, TCP, UDP, SSH, Telnet) and asks its full form, its job or its port, or asks about upload and download.

types.name: Email fields, protocols and services
types.description: Asks about email fields (CC, BCC), folders, SMTP, POP3, IMAP, email service providers or email shortcuts such as Gmail keys.

types.name: Network types, topologies and media
types.description: Asks about PAN, LAN, MAN, WAN, topologies (star, bus, ring, mesh), transmission media or transmission modes.

types.name: Network devices and connectors
types.description: Names a device (hub, switch, bridge, router, gateway, repeater, modem, NIC) or a connector (VGA, HDMI, RJ-45) and asks what it does.

types.name: OSI and TCP/IP layers
types.description: Asks which OSI or TCP/IP layer does a job, the order of the layers, or the layer a device or protocol works at.

types.name: Online threats and protection
types.description: Asks about online threats (phishing, malware, tracking cookies, DoS) or protections (firewall, encryption, VPN, HTTPS) while using the Internet.
